name: RxWeb
description_en:
RxWeb is a collection of developer libraries and application-architecture templates associated with Angular, ASP.NET Core and related web development. Its official About page identifies Radixweb as publisher and explicitly says developers can download and use it free of cost. It is not documented here as a managed application-hosting subscription.

This profile follows two distinct entry points: Angular client-side form validation and an ASP.NET Core clean-architecture project template. They do not establish that every package has identical dependencies or a common current release. The backend quickstart names older tooling, so compatibility with a team’s chosen runtime needs separate verification.
description_zh:
RxWeb 是与 Angular、ASP.NET Core 等网页开发相关的开发库及应用架构模板集合。官方介绍页指出 Radixweb 为发布方，并明确表示开发者可免费下载、使用。本次文档没有将其描述为托管应用订阅服务。

本文沿 Angular 客户端表单校验与 ASP.NET Core 整洁架构模板两个不同入口研究，不能据此认定所有包具有相同依赖或共同当前版本。后端快速入门列较旧工具，需另行验证团队所选运行环境兼容性。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Choose a package before choosing a deployment model
sections.title_zh: 先选开发包，再确定部署方式
sections.en: The Angular introduction installs @rxweb/reactive-form-validators and describes client-side validation for reactive and template-driven forms. The backend guide instead begins with a Visual Studio template and RxWebCore CLI. These are development components rather than evidence of an automatically provisioned server, database or hosted account. A team evaluating only form validation need not adopt the complete backend architecture; a backend-template evaluation must inspect the generated application and its dependencies.
sections.zh: Angular 入门安装 @rxweb/reactive-form-validators，介绍响应式及模板驱动表单客户端校验；后端指南则从 Visual Studio 模板与 RxWebCore CLI 开始。它们是开发组件，不能证明会自动提供服务器、数据库或托管账户。仅评估表单校验的团队不必同时采用整个后端架构；评估后端模板则需检查生成应用与依赖。

sections.title_en: Make a small required-field form and inspect failure
sections.title_zh: 建立小型必填表单并检查失败状态
sections.en: The required guide creates a FormGroup through Angular FormBuilder and attaches RxwebValidators.required() to a field. Its HTML reads the field error message and disables Submit while the form is invalid; the unfilled official demo was observed displaying a required message and disabled button. A proposed signup form should separately check blank input, corrected input and server rejection. This client-side example does not prove the server validates a request or prevents direct API calls. No package was run or form submitted here.
sections.zh: required 指南通过 Angular FormBuilder 创建 FormGroup，为字段附加 RxwebValidators.required()。HTML 读取字段错误消息，表单无效时禁用 Submit；已观察到官方空表单示例显示必填消息及禁用按钮。建议注册表单分别检查空输入、修正输入及服务器拒绝。客户端示例不能证明服务器校验请求或阻止 API 直调。本次未运行包或提交表单。

sections.en: RequiredConfig supports conditionalExpression plus a custom message or messageKey from ReactiveFormConfig. The condition receives current and root FormGroup values; the guide shows both function and string expressions, but warns that a fixed boolean/no-expression return is unsuitable. Its dynamic JSON example specifically excludes function-based conditionalExpression. Check the exact package version and configuration path before sending a server-defined rule to the client, and test when a dependency changes rather than assuming all rule representations are interchangeable.
sections.zh: RequiredConfig 支持 conditionalExpression，以及自定义 message 或 ReactiveFormConfig 的 messageKey。条件接收当前与根 FormGroup 值；指南展示函数及字符串表达式，但提示固定布尔／无表达式返回不适用。动态 JSON 示例明确不支持函数式 conditionalExpression。向客户端传服务器定义规则前应核对具体包版本及配置路径，并测试依赖变化，不能假设所有规则表示方式可互换。

sections.title_en: Scaffolding does not replace application authorization
sections.title_zh: 脚手架不能代替应用授权核对
sections.en: The backend quickstart generates Models, BoundedContext, UnitOfWork, Infrastructure, Domain and Api projects. It describes DbContexts, data-manipulation methods, centralized token/access operations and custom domain logic. Its main database includes users, roles, role permissions and user-role mappings, while a log database records exceptions, requests and entity changes. Use an isolated example to verify permitted and rejected API calls and inspect logs. The guide’s authentication sequence alone does not establish resistance to brute force or correct authorization for a particular application.
sections.zh: 后端快速入门生成 Models、BoundedContext、UnitOfWork、Infrastructure、Domain 与 Api 项目，介绍 DbContext、数据操作、集中 token／访问处理及自定义领域逻辑。主库含用户、角色、角色权限及用户角色映射，日志库记录异常、请求及实体改动。应使用隔离示例验证允许与拒绝的 API 调用并检查日志。指南中的认证顺序本身不能证明抗暴力尝试或具体应用授权正确。

sections.title_en: Treat the quickstart prerequisites as a compatibility check
sections.title_zh: 将入门依赖作为兼容检查点
sections.en: The backend page still specifies Visual Studio 2019 above 16.3.4 and .NET Core SDK 3.1. Its footer displays version 1.9.3.739, which is not enough to identify the latest release of every RxWeb package. Before adoption, compare the intended framework/runtime and package versions, inspect maintenance and migration requirements, and compile a disposable project. No current support matrix, release status, vulnerability assessment or production recovery behavior was established in this research.
sections.zh: 后端页仍列 Visual Studio 2019 高于 16.3.4 及 .NET Core SDK 3.1；页脚展示 1.9.3.739，不能据此确定所有 RxWeb 包最新版本。采用前应比较目标框架／运行时与包版本，检查维护、迁移要求并编译可丢弃项目。本次未建立当前支持矩阵、发布状态、漏洞评估或生产恢复行为。

sections.title_en: Free code use is separate from operating an application
sections.title_zh: 免费代码使用与应用运行费用分开
sections.en: The official About page expressly permits downloading and using RxWeb free of cost; it does not publish a managed hosting entitlement or runtime allowance. Teams remain responsible for their chosen infrastructure, database and development work. The documentation footer links code licensing to MIT on GitHub, but the full license and coverage across packages/templates were not examined here. Preserve that license-scope gap instead of turning a footer label into a verified grant for the complete ecosystem. No paid support terms were established.
sections.zh: 官方介绍页明确说 RxWeb 可免费下载、使用，但没有提供托管运行权或运行额度；团队仍负责自选基础设施、数据库及开发工作。文档页脚将代码许可链接到 GitHub 的 MIT，但本次未检查完整许可及其对各包／模板的覆盖。需保留许可范围缺口，不能把页脚标签转为整个生态已核实授权。本次未确认付费支持条款。
